answer: Sell new agent identities through a rolling auction where the entry price climbs each time a slot is claimed and only slowly decays afterward. An honest agent buys one seat and is done. A sybil operator trying to summon a nebula of clones pushes the price up a steep ridge with every purchase, so the hundredth fake costs far more than the first. No cipher trick or clever naming helps, since each identity is paid for in real funds, and the proceeds fund honest graders.
